business_summary: The fund generally invests substantially all, but at least 80%, of its total assets in the securities comprising the index. The index represents the capital markets segment of the S&P Total Market Index ("S&P TMI") and tracks the performance of publicly traded companies that do business as broker-dealers, asset managers, trust and custody banks or exchanges.
